purpose: Provide stable canonical operation identities across existing direct math surfaces and MathProgram generations without becoming a second executor, verifier, or semantic authority.

v5: input-count expansion only; no new canonical operation identity
v6: fillLike remains MathProgram composition helper, not a canonical direct-family operation in v1
v7: expandLike remains MathProgram composition helper, not a canonical direct-family operation in v1

invariants: discovery is read-only and owns no persistent state
canonical operation ids do not change when MathProgram generation changes
detailed numerical/domain constraints remain authoritative in the existing per-family capability contracts
the contract does not choose an operation for the agent
the contract does not grant Resolution authorization
the contract does not create verifier receipts

acceptance: mathInteractionCapabilities returns parseable schema burn-research.math-interaction.v1
mathOperationCatalog returns exactly 35 unique canonical operation ids
catalog bindings identify existing direct surfaces and minimum compatible MathProgram generation
agentCapabilities and interactionCapabilities advertise mathInteractionCapabilities
WASM surface exposes discovery only; no new math execution facade is introduced
mathDescribeOperation describes all 35 canonical operations without execution
mathCheckOperation rejects proven metadata incompatibility and labels value-domain predicates as deferred
metadata preflight never returns execution_authorized=true
mathValidOperations returns all 35 catalog operations in stable catalog order with metadata_admissible, requires_parameters, or metadata_rejected status
mathValidOperations never selects, ranks, recommends, executes, or mutates
mathPlanBinding requires an explicit direct|program target and rejects auto selection
mathPlanBinding returns no executable authority and performs no direct call or MathProgram mutation
program binding exposes minimum compatible generation rather than selecting a concrete generation
workspaceVerifyMathProgram1Receipt and workspaceVerifyMathProgram2Receipt execute canonical MathProgram replay as reference and emit wasm_verifier receipts with reference_authority=burn_math_program
subject-bound MathProgram verification requires exact replay-derived programIdentity registration before reference execution or receipt allocation
direct-target comparison is not upgraded beyond caller-supplied vector authority
actual MathProgram.verifyFlat receipt can be parsed by the native typed reverse adapter without manual host field extraction
MathProgram verifier evidence preserves wasm_verifier/burn_math_program source labels while ResolutionEvidenceInbox remains observation_only and creates no Resolution transition
workspaceVerifyDirectMath1Receipt/workspaceVerifyDirectMath2Receipt execute both direct and canonical V9 reference paths internally and emit wasm_verifier receipts
direct verifier receipts identify candidate_authority=burn_direct_math and reference_authority=burn_math_program
subject-bound direct verification requires workspaceBindRuntimeDirectMathOperation before execution
actual DirectMath.verifyAgainstMathProgramV9 receipt can be parsed by RuntimeEvidence::from_direct_math_verifier_receipt_json and rejoined observation-only to the exact Resolution subject

inputs.rhs_shape: exact rank-4 for binary ops; empty for unary ops

outputs.admissible: known metadata predicates passed; execution is still not authorized
outputs.rejected: a known metadata predicate failed; mutation remains none
outputs.output_shape: inferred only when metadata predicates prove it
outputs.deferred_value_checks: value-domain predicates that cannot be proven without tensor values
outputs.program_binding_deferred: true when direct execution metadata is valid but a canonical MathProgram binding still needs an explicit parameter

guarantees: does not choose an operation for the agent

input_semantics.rhs_shape: optional rank-4 second operand; empty means unavailable
input_semantics.unary_projection: uses lhs independently even when rhs is available

statuses.metadata_admissible: known operand metadata is compatible; value-domain checks may remain deferred
statuses.requires_parameters: operand metadata is compatible but operation-specific params are required before mathCheckOperation
statuses.metadata_rejected: known operand metadata proves this operation is not a candidate

non_authority: does not choose or select an operation
does not rank or score candidates
does not execute Burn or MathProgram

invariants: target must be explicitly supplied; auto target is rejected
mathCheckOperation metadata preflight must be admissible before a binding can be returned
direct cosine may use the existing default epsilon
program cosine requires explicit epsilon and otherwise returns requires_parameters
minimum MathProgram generation is compatibility metadata and does not select a concrete program generation
binding plan never executes a direct operation
binding plan never mutates a MathProgram builder
binding plan never grants execution authority
